### Financial Instruments & Pricing

*   [vanna (⭐2)](https://github.com/heykav/vanna) - `Python` - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P\&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
*   [stochPathSim (⭐15)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/stochPathSim) - `Python` - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
*   [CustomDerivative](https://cran.r-project.org/package=CustomDerivative) - `R` - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. [GitHub (⭐2)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/CustomDerivative)
*   [stochastic-rs](https://stochastic.rust-dd.com) - `Rust` `Python` - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. [GitHub (⭐194)](https://github.com/rust-dd/stochastic-rs)

### Technical Indicators

*   [Repaint Check (⭐0)](https://github.com/arnjesix/stratcorealpha-pine-repaint-check) - `Pine` - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
*   [yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1)](https://github.com/eminsk/yfinance-ta-patterns) - `Python` - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
*   [technical-indicators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Pinxitu/technical-indicators) - `TypeScript` - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
*   [gamma-seed (⭐2)](https://github.com/Timonkru/gamma-seed) - `Python` `Pine` `Options` - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. [Website](https://kruegeralgorithms.com/en/research)

### Trading & Backtesting

*   [QuantDinger (⭐13k)](https://github.com/OpenByteInc/QuantDinger) - `Python` - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
*   [ALPHAC (⭐1)](https://github.com/arhancanli/alphac) - `Python` - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
*   [trading-research-agents (⭐36)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/trading-research-agents) - `Python` `MCP` - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
*   [Desic Terminal (⭐33)](https://github.com/xiazhi88/Desic-Terminal) - `Rust` `TypeScript` - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited\_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
*   [Blave Agent (⭐113)](https://github.com/Blave-TW/blave-agent) - `Python` `JavaScript` `Electron` - macOS desktop workspace where your own Claude Code or Codex writes a trading strategy, backtests it with a Monte Carlo permutation test, a parameter-plateau scan and walk-forward, and runs it live through deterministic scheduled code with no LLM in the order loop (Binance, OKX, BingX, Gate.io, Bybit, paper trading).
*   [Evidence Deflator (⭐0)](https://github.com/Beltran12138/evidence-deflator) - `Python` `MCP` - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
*   [OpenBacktesting (⭐6)](https://github.com/lucidcog/openbacktesting) - `Python` - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
*   [AlphaFinch (⭐2)](https://github.com/shloksobti/alphafinch) - `Python` `LLM` - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
*   [canli-backtest (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-backtest) - `Python` - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.
*   [tilt-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/ssap-pa/tilt-check) - `Python` `TabPFN` `Gemma` - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders.
*   [Optra (⭐24)](https://github.com/DuFanYin/optra) - `C++` `Python` - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools.
*   [Sharpen (⭐8)](https://github.com/bigcan/sharpen) - `Python` - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0).
*   [backtest-audit-kit (⭐0)](https://github.com/rytjy/backtest-audit-kit) - `Python` - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots.
*   [Lumina Capital (⭐4)](https://github.com/ramuza0113-sketch/lumina-ai-hedge-fund) - `Python` - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM.
*   [TokIO (⭐4)](https://github.com/Kuzi-DEV/Tokio-ai) - `Python` `Pine Script` - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly.
*   [perpbrain-sdk](https://github.com/PERPBRAIN/perpbrain-sdk) - `TypeScript` `MCP` - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs.
*   [LR-AutoInvest (⭐0)](https://github.com/LLR6/LR-AutoInvest) - `Python` `CLI` - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans.
*   [matching-engine](https://rekurt.github.io/matching-engine/) - `Rust` - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/rekurt/matching-engine)
*   [tradefloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/simoncoombes/tradefloor) - `Python` `Rust` - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly.
*   [tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp) - `Python` `MCP` - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges.
*   [IBKR-Telegram (⭐2)](https://github.com/GeiserX/IBKR-Telegram) - `Python` `Telegram` - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P\&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals.
*   [nt8-mcp (⭐24)](https://github.com/tbraman-dev/nt8-mcp) - `C#` `Python` `MCP` - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default.

### Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

*   [portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3)](https://github.com/garroshub/portfolio-risk-lab) - `Python` - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints.
*   [dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0)](https://github.com/BlitzTrading/dca-ladder-calculator) - `JavaScript` `Crypto` - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order.
*   [Deadlatch (⭐0)](https://github.com/Diabloluo/deadlatch) - `Python` `MCP` - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log.
*   [stochastly-calculators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Stochastly/stochastly-calculators) - `TypeScript` - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper.
*   [position-sizing-data (⭐1)](https://github.com/tk25719/position-sizing-data) - `Data` - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples.

### Time Series Analysis

*   [NoiseFloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/beepboop2025/noisefloor) - `Python` `MCP` - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks.

### Market Data & Data Sources

*   [prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - `Python` `JavaScript` `Data` - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.
*   [canli-pit-lake (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-pit-lake) - `Python` `DuckDB` `Parquet` - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept.
*   [Gloomberb (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb) - `TypeScript` `Bun` - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app.
*   [Fonrex](https://fonrex.io) - `Python` `Docker` `REST` - Self-hosted financial data API for European and US markets: prices per listing, cross-checked fundamentals from 18 sources, DCF valuation and Fama/French factors in your own PostgreSQL. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/fonrex/fonrex)
*   [Seiche (⭐1)](https://github.com/beepboop2025/seiche) - `Python` `REST` `MCP` - Money-market and dollar-funding research with public-source collectors, historical observations, separate release and retrieval clocks, and explicit coverage gaps.
*   [CNEquity (⭐730)](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity) - `Python` `MCP` `A-shares` - Self-hosted China A-share data lake that keeps 55 datasets (prices, financials, capital flows, corporate events, futures and options) in local Parquet with incremental updates, point-in-time queries, delisted-stock retention, DuckDB SQL and a read-only MCP server.
*   [alphai-tui (⭐77)](https://github.com/makeev/alphai-tui) - `Rust` `TUI` - Terminal stock dashboard with keyless quotes, candlestick charts and portfolio tracking, plus optional news and SEC filing views powered by the AlphAI API.
*   [yfinance-ir (⭐2)](https://github.com/Fazel94/yfinance-ir) - `Python` - yfinance-shaped market data for Iranian markets: TSETMC equities, ETFs, indices and option chains, Codal financial statements, TGJU FX and gold, SCI CPI and Iranian crypto exchanges.
*   [ws-wire-audit (⭐0)](https://github.com/Robin1987China/ws-wire-audit) - `Python` - WebSocket wire-level measurement tool for exchange market-data feeds: frame and control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire byte ratios, compression negotiation checks, and a documented API-contract audit.
*   [edgar-full-text-search-examples (⭐0)](https://github.com/svitury/edgar-full-text-search-examples) - `Python` `SEC EDGAR` - Stdlib-only EDGAR full-text search to CSV that splits date ranges to get past the 10,000-result cap.
*   [ninjatrader-to-parquet (⭐10)](https://github.com/tbraman-dev/ninjatrader-to-parquet) - `Python` - NinjaTrader 8 .ncd tick and minute history files to Parquet without NinjaTrader running; row-exact against NinjaTrader's own export, incremental re-runs.

### Prediction Markets

*   [oracle3 (⭐476)](https://github.com/YichengYang-Ethan/oracle3-prediction-market-agent) - `Python` `MCP` - Trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related event contracts, statistical arbitrage, and live or paper execution on Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana.
*   [OpenThomas (⭐24)](https://github.com/PredictionMarketTrader/openthomas) - `Python` `MCP` - Autonomous weather-market trading agent for Kalshi and Polymarket that learns per-station forecast bias from leak-free hindcasts and sizes positions with fractional Kelly under hard risk limits.
*   [pm-hftbacktest (⭐125)](https://github.com/mileswangs/pm-hftbacktest) - `Rust` `Python` - High-frequency trading and market-making backtesting for Polymarket, written in Rust, with queue position, latency and maker/taker fee models applied to tick-level L2 order book and trade data.

### Visualization

*   [Flowdepth (⭐18)](https://github.com/Niketion/flowdepth) - `Rust` `Desktop` - Open-source crypto order-flow terminal with footprint charts, historical L2 liquidity heatmaps, volume bubbles, CVD, and BTC/ETH/SOL options GEX analytics.
*   [Kandle](https://kernel-hunter.github.io/kandle/) - `TypeScript` `MCP` - Browser charting app for crypto, stocks and forex with indicators, a scripting language with strategy backtests, alerts, bar replay and an MCP server for AI agents. [GitHub (⭐0)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle)
*   [OpenKline](https://rekurt.github.io/openkline/) - `TypeScript` - Canvas-based OHLCV charting engine with technical indicators, drawing tools, and streaming-data support. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/rekurt/openkline)
*   [TradeCanvas (⭐22)](https://github.com/bonguynvan/tradecanvas) - `TypeScript` - Financial charting library for the web, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL: 18 chart types, 111 indicators, drawing tools, live exchange feeds, orders on the chart, replay and backtesting.

### Quant Research Environments

*   [AxonX (⭐5)](https://github.com/FlowLLM-AI/AxonX) - `Python` `MCP` - Agent-native quantitative research harness with plugin-based tasks for data processing, factor analysis, model training, and backtesting, traceable artifacts, and CLI and web interfaces.
*   [thesis-ci (⭐1)](https://github.com/kentian742-creator/thesis-ci) - `Python` `CLI` `YAML` - Linter and CI for written investment theses that fails a number without a filing citation, freezes test thresholds once results are out, and Brier-scores forecasts.
*   [easy-stock (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/jundizhou/easy-stock) - `Go` `React` `A-shares` - Local-first AI research workbench for China A-shares: unified market overview, theme radar, limit-up ladder and sentiment-cycle analysis, AI stock reports, portfolio inspection, and agent-based collection of post-market commentary with evidence tracing.
*   [AlphaLattice (⭐1)](https://github.com/xinglin-li/alphalattice) - `Python` `Claude Code` `Codex` - Local research workbench that a coding agent drives from one sentence: dated US large-cap research positions bounded by each date's information cutoff, SEC-filing evidence review, and an investment committee that changes no numbers.
*   [SmartMoney-Cub (⭐27)](https://github.com/myc0576/SmartMoney-Cub) - `Python` `LLM` - Local-first, agent-agnostic trading journal and review harness that freezes point-in-time run envelopes and evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and evaluates rule candidates against a frozen 240-case finance benchmark, with no order or broker access.

### Reproducing Works, Training & Books

*   [cfa-frm-formula-sheets (⭐0)](https://github.com/marfa77/cfa-frm-formula-sheets) - `Training` `Data` - Machine-readable CFA Level I/II and FRM Part I formula reference in LaTeX and JSON/CSV with variable definitions and official topic weights.
*   [EPSILON](https://epsilonfield.space/) - `Python` - Open-source backtesting simulator with a 25-minute Assumption Clinic worksheet that teaches students to inspect backtest assumptions using published failed cases. [GitHub (⭐204)](https://github.com/DresdenGman/EPSILON-trading-simulator)

items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Gemini Safety Net (⭐3)](https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net) - Gemini CLI extension that runs [cc-safety-net (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/kenryu42/cc-safety-net) as a `BeforeTool` hook.
